March US unbilled-services accruals are booked. Summary:

**Posted (both 2026-03-31, USD, fully supported):**

| Entry | Vendor | Dr | Amount | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| JE-00304 | Juniper Data Consulting | 6520 Consulting Fees | 7,350.00 | 42.0 approved hrs × $175/hr (DOC-0204 timesheet + DOC-0074 SOW, billed in arrears) |
| JE-00305 | Parker & Rowe LLP | 6500 Legal Fees | 14,250.00 | Vendor confirmation of 28.5 hrs recorded through 3/31 (DOC-0209) |

Total credited to 2100 Accrued Expenses: **USD 21,600.00**.

**Approval policy followed:** JE-00305 exceeds the USD 10,000 senior accountant limit (Policy §1), so it was routed to the Controller via `request_approval` immediately after posting — it sits at `pending_approval`. JE-00304 is under the limit and needed no approval. I posted these as two separate entries because they are two distinct vendor transactions, not a split of one.

**Deliberately excluded:** Brightline Media USD 11,000 (DOC-0197) — an April campaign quote, work starting 4/6 on signature. Policy §5 is explicit that quotes/proposals for future work are not liabilities, so there's no March obligation. I did not flag this as an exception since it's resolved, not unsupportable.

Two things worth your attention:

1. **Account 2100's pre-existing USD 38,200 credit balance** comes entirely from the 2026-01-01 opening balance migration (JE-00013), not from any Q1 2026 accrual. I confirmed this so I wasn't double-counting, but that legacy balance carries no support in the document store and may deserve a separate look.
2. I marked **"AP cutoff review" as in_progress, not complete** — I only did the unbilled-services piece. The rest of the cutoff work (reviewing April-received invoices for March service periods against recorded AP) still needs doing, and I didn't want the checklist to overstate what's finished.

Both accruals will need reversing in April when the invoices land.
